builtin_interfaces.Time.description:
This message communicates ROS Time defined here:
https://design.ros2.org/articles/clock_and_time.html

sec.description: The seconds component, valid over all int32 values.

canopy_msgs.WorldObject.description:
One object the world model fused from several views. Poses are in the header frame of the
enclosing array, normally `map`.

Constants:
STATE_ACTIVE=0
STATE_STALE=1
STATE_REMOVED=2

confidence.description: Share of all label votes held by `label`, 0..1.

id.description: Stable for the life of the world file: "O12". Never reused after removal.

label.description: The detector label with the most votes.

name.description: Canonical name and one-line caption from the describer. Empty until described.

pose.description: Centre of the oriented bounding box; only yaw is set in the orientation.

room_id.description:
Room the footprint centre falls in, and the object it rests on. Empty when unknown or on the
floor.

size.description: Full extents along the box axes, m.

geometry_msgs.Point.description: This contains the position of a point in free space

geometry_msgs.Pose.description: A representation of pose in free space, composed of position and orientation.

geometry_msgs.Quaternion.description: This represents an orientation in free space in quaternion form.

geometry_msgs.Vector3.description: This represents a vector in free space.

x.description:
This is semantically different than a point.
A vector is always anchored at the origin.
When a transform is applied to a vector, only the rotational component is applied.

found.description: False with a coverage figure means "not in the part the camera has seen", not "absent".
